14.stem:
EITHER
a. i. The printed question asks why it is better to launch a spacecraft into orbit from a location away from the equator. Justify your answer with a mathematical relation.
   ii. Calculate Earth’s escape speed using $M=6.0\times10^{24}\,\mathrm{kg}$, $R=6.4\times10^6\,\mathrm m$, $g=9.8\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ and $G=6.67\times10^{-11}\,\mathrm{N\,m^2\,kg^{-2}}$.
OR
b. A 1200 kg car starts with speed 27.5 m/s. Its engine applies a uniform force of 3500 N. Find the power at the end of 8 s.

15.stem:

OR
